## Paper submission

- [ ] I changed only my folder `papers/<team-name>/`.
- [ ] `bash papers/<team-name>/build.sh` succeeds locally ("Paper validation successful").
- [ ] The PDF has at most four pages, including references.
- [ ] `metadata.tex`: title, abstract, keywords and **project repository URL** are filled in.
- [ ] `metadata.tex`: every author has an `\AddAuthor` block with a 50–80 word third-person biography (portrait and links optional).
- [ ] Figures are local files in my `figures/` folder and sources are in my `references.bib`; labels have a team prefix.
- [ ] The pull request's **validate** check is green.

## Publication of personal data

- [ ] I understand that this repository is **public** and that the author information (names or pseudonyms, biographies, links, portraits/avatars) is visible on the internet **already in this pull request and my branch**, before the proceedings are published.
- [ ] I provide this information **voluntarily**. Where I do not want to use my real name or photo, I use a pseudonym and/or an avatar that follows the netiquette.
- [ ] I only published personal data and images of myself, or of people who agreed, and I have the rights to all images.
